more_beautiful.reason: B's warm rice-paper palette, Kaiti masthead with a seal and brush-stroke underline, and clear card hierarchy look finished and inviting, while A is an austere all-gray form whose only flourish is two small glyph cells.

less_generic.reason: B's seal, calligraphic title, 老年大学 label and warm palette make the whole page read as this calligraphy class's own page, whereas A's clever 米字格 tracing glyphs sit inside an otherwise stock gray form with no school identity (though B's motifs are familiar 国风 tropes).

better_overall.reason: B gives learners in their seventies bigger text and buttons, an explicit 已选 selected state, a review step that shows the phone number before sending, and a reassuring success page, and gives the school a roster, a CSV export and an easy config file; its few invented details are easy to edit.

A: Every requested fact (Wednesday 2-4pm, 12 sessions, 300 yuan) and all three fields are present, worded exactly as given, with nothing invented
Class options use 米字格 practice-grid cells with hollow red tracing characters (楷/行) that turn to solid ink when chosen, a genuinely calligraphy-specific idea

Simple one-step flow: plain-Chinese error summary plus inline errors (e.g. 手机号应该是11位数字，您填了10位), a failure message that keeps the input, and a clear receipt with the phone in 3-4-4 groups and 这一页可以截图留着
Careful Chinese typesetting (CJK-digit autospace, no orphaned 点, balanced wraps), and a compact page that needs little scrolling
Owner gets a CSV that opens in Excel/WPS, with duplicate submissions merged
B: Larger type throughout (20px body, 24px labels, 26px inputs and course facts, 46px title), 64px inputs and a 70px full-width button
Cohesive, warm design: rice-paper background, Kaiti title with a seal and brush stroke, vermilion button, strong card hierarchy, 老年大学 shown at the top

Elderly-friendly flow: 一共 3 项，都要填写; a 已选 tag on the chosen class; a review step with the phone in 3-4-4 groups; the phone's Back button returns to the form; a success page with a green check, 接下来…请留意手机来电 and 再帮别人报名
Robust input handling (full-width digits, +86, stray spaces in names), inline errors with a ! badge, focus moved to the first error, and a network-failure message

For the owner: config.js for course facts (empty location and contact rows stay hidden, and adding a phone number shows a big call button), a password-protected roster by class, CSV export, dark mode and a no-JavaScript fallback

A: Visually austere: all-gray palette with a black button and no school name or identity; the desktop view is a wide, bland form with a sidebar
Hints and class descriptions are about 18px gray, smaller than ideal for this audience; apart from the glyph, the selected state (a faint gray fill) is subtle
The confirmation shows learners a raw placeholder, 待学校填写：开课日期、上课地点、交费方式
No chance to check the phone number before submitting, and nothing tells learners what happens next or how their phone number is used
The 行 glyph is set in Kaiti rather than running script, and the hairline outline glyphs look faint
B: Invents details not in the brief: class descriptions (从握笔和基本笔画学起, 已有楷书基础), a privacy promise, and a promise that the school will phone about fees and the first lesson
The extra review step and a longer page mean more taps and scrolling than the brief's 操作要简单 strictly needs
Seal, brush-stroke underline and beige paper are stock 国风 motifs, and the title's wide letter-spacing is a little loose
Refuses a second class for the same person and says 请联系老师, but by default no contact number is shown
